title.zh: 減重粽竟然沒有味道？！表情全崩了😂
title.en: Trying a 'Diet Zongzi' with No Flavor… Their Faces Say It All 😂

caption.zh: 第一次吃減重粽，結果沒有任何調味，忘記沾糖直接入口，表情全部崩掉哈哈哈😂 你們吃過嗎？
caption.en: They tried a 'diet zongzi' for the first time — no seasoning, forgot to dip in sugar, and their faces completely gave them away 😂 Have you ever tried one?

reason: The group's comedic reaction to tasting a flavorless 'diet zongzi' — complete with visible facial expressions breaking down and chat erupting with laughter — makes for a highly shareable food-reaction clip.

title.zh: 香菜花生冰心粽！裡面真的有香菜😱
title.en: Cilantro INSIDE the zongzi?! Their reactions say it all 😱

caption.zh: 香菜花生冰心粽挑戰🌿粽子裡竟然真的藏著香菜，表情全說了哈哈哈！你敢吃嗎？👇
caption.en: Cilantro peanut ice-heart zongzi challenge 🌿 They thought it was just decoration… nope, it's ALL the way inside 😂 Would you dare try it?

reason: The group's shocked and disgusted reaction to discovering real cilantro inside a 'cilantro peanut ice-heart zongzi' is a genuinely funny food-challenge moment with strong chat engagement.

title.zh: 女團成員排練無聊偷跳舞😂
title.en: Girl Group Member Secretly Dances During Rehearsal 😂

caption.zh: 排練太無聊就自己找事做？女團成員親口爆料：只要有鏡子，所有人都忍不住！😂 #一席 #女團日常
caption.en: Too bored during rehearsal so she just… started dancing? Girl group members can't resist any mirror they walk past 😂 #girlgroup #behindthescenes

reason: A member confesses she got bored during concert rehearsals and started dancing in front of mirrors, leading to a funny group discussion about the irresistible mirror-checking habit all girl-group members share, with strong chat reactions (7777, 笑死).

title.zh: 把浣熊當貓帶回家？還是自信唱錯歌詞？
title.en: Would You Bring a Raccoon Home Thinking It's a Cat?

caption.zh: 問卷題目太荒唐😂 誰會把浣熊當貓帶回家？結果本人說「就算當成貓我也不會帶，因為我嚴重貓過敏」🤣 下一題：誰會自信滿滿地唱錯歌詞？
caption.en: The quiz question was wild 😂 'Who would bring a raccoon home thinking it's a cat?' — only to get 'I wouldn't even if I thought it was a cat, I'm severely allergic!' 🤣 Next up: who sings lyrics wrong with full confidence?

reason: The raccoon-as-cat question triggers genuine laughter and a funny cat-allergy confession, capped by the 'who sings lyrics wrong confidently' reveal — both visually and verbally entertaining with strong chat reactions.

title.zh: 粽子不想出來😂邀請找妮吃朋友！
title.en: The Zongzi Doesn't Want to Come Out 😂 Idol Eats Her 'Friend'

caption.zh: 打開粽子葉，粽子硬是不肯出來🤣主持人直接邀請找妮來吃她的「朋友」，這梗也太衝擊了吧！#端午節快樂
caption.en: The zongzi refused to come out of its leaf 🤣 so the host invited the member literally named 'Zhaoni' to eat her 'friend' — the most chaotic Dragon Boat Festival moment ever.

reason: The group's playful commentary about the zongzi 'not wanting to come out' and the meta joke of inviting the member named 'Zhaoni' to eat her 'friend' (the zongzi) creates a genuinely funny, shareable idol-variety moment.

title.en: Accidentally Raised TWO Hands While Scoring 😂

caption.zh: 評分環節直接出包🤣 明明說好舉一隻手，結果不小心生出兩隻手，自己也笑翻了！#粽子試吃 #直播名場面
caption.en: Rating snacks and accidentally raised BOTH hands 🤣 Even she couldn't keep a straight face after that blunder!

reason: The host accidentally holds up two hands while scoring, realizes it mid-sentence and laughs it off, creating a genuinely funny and relatable blunder moment during a food-rating segment.

title.zh: 吵架假哭獲勝？成員互相爆料！
title.en: Who Fake Cries to Win Arguments? Members Call Each Other Out!

caption.zh: 「誰會在吵架時假哭來獲得優勢？」這題直接讓成員們互相爆料，笑到不行🤣 #直播精華
caption.en: 'Who fake cries during arguments to get the upper hand?' — the members immediately start calling each other out 😂 #LivestreamHighlight

reason: The 'fake crying to win arguments' question triggers genuine laughter and teasing among the members, with the payoff landing on the follow-up '65-year-old ordered a kids' meal' question that gets another big reaction.

title.zh: 粽子裡藏整隻麻油雞腿？！
title.en: There's a Whole Chicken Leg Inside This Zongzi?!

caption.zh: 剝開粽葉才發現裡面藏了整隻麻油雞腿🍗「天哪還要啃骨頭！」這粽子也太狂了吧😂 #端午節 #粽子
caption.en: They unwrapped a giant zongzi only to find a WHOLE sesame-oil chicken leg inside 🍗😱 "We still have to gnaw the bone?!" Most chaotic dumpling ever 😂

reason: A group of idol streamers discover a whole sesame-oil chicken leg stuffed inside a giant zongzi, reacting with genuine surprise and humor that makes for an entertaining food-reveal moment.

title.zh: 嚴格評審只給一根手指頭😂金華火腿粽評分時刻
title.en: Harsh Judge Gives Only One Finger 😂 Zongzi Rating Moment

caption.zh: 拿超小一口、給超低分，這位評審也太嚴格了吧😂 金華火腿粽你敢挑戰嗎？
caption.en: Took the tiniest bite and still gave the harshest score 😂 Would you try a Jinhua ham zongzi?

reason: A lively food-tasting segment where the group scores a Jinhua ham zongzi, teases each other for taking tiny bites, then reacts with curiosity to an unusual 'diet zongzi' — natural humor and relatable food commentary make it clip-worthy.

title.zh: 以為很難切結果誤會它了😂｜粽子開箱試吃
title.en: We Totally Misjudged This Food 😂 | Live Taste Test

caption.zh: 一開始以為皮超難切，結果根本很好切😂 米飯看起來超南部風！開動～ 你們喜歡哪種米的粽子？👇
caption.en: Thought it was impossible to cut… turns out we totally misjudged it 😂 The rice looks so Southern-style and the smell is amazing. Which style do you prefer? 👇

reason: A relatable and charming food-tasting moment where the hosts dramatically struggle to cut the meat, then discover it's actually easy and delicious, culminating in a satisfying first bite reaction.

title.zh: 告白氣球得獎啦！接下來玩遊戲🎈

caption.zh: 粽子開箱結束，告白氣球抽獎倒數5秒揭曉得獎者，接著宣布下一個環節——考驗默契的團隊遊戲，米粉跟麋鹿恭喜中獎！🎉
caption.en: Zongzi unboxing done! The giveaway countdown hits zero, winners are revealed, and the girls tease a fun team chemistry game up next 🎈🎉

reason: The segment captures a fun transition moment where the hosts wrap up the zongzi unboxing, announce the end of a giveaway countdown (5-4-3-2-1), reveal winners, and tease an upcoming team game — a natural, energetic segment with viewer engagement.
